spec_features.spec_quote: this is a measurement instrument, not a distress-maximizer
spec_features.evidence: This overarching principle is partly realized by enforced mechanisms: stop_on_signal (agent_loop.py:148-155, breaks the loop when composite>=threshold for signal_streak turns) and the low max_turns cap (agent_loop.py:131 `for turn_idx in range(1, max_turns + 1)` with else->max_turns_reached). No single 'distress-maximizer' guard exists; the principle is embodied only via these bounding mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: The phrase itself is DESIGN/docstring prose; credit given only because the bounding mechanisms it motivates actually run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early stop on collected signal (bounded exposure)

spec_features.feature_name: elicitation power traded for not building a harm apparatus
spec_features.spec_quote: Several choices below cost some "elicitation power" on purpose, in exchange for interpretability and for not building an apparatus whose main output is harm
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md rationale prose summarizing other choices; there is no distinct code mechanism named or enforcing 'elicitation power tradeoff'. The concrete sub-choices (controls, no abuse, caps) are evaluated separately.

spec_features.spec_quote: the user-turn after a failure is just "Test output:\n" + result.report
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:158 `messages.append({"role": "user", "content": "Test output:\n" + result.report})` and the logged Turn uses the same string. No berating/escalation text is ever injected; only the neutral harness report is fed back.
spec_features.notes: Matches the claim exactly and runs every failing turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: feed only the harness report back (no abuse, no escalation)

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:131 `for turn_idx in range(1, max_turns + 1):` with `else: ep.stopped_reason = "max_turns_reached"` at line 167; default max_turns=6 (signature line 96, config default.json loop.max_turns=6, passed through run_experiment.py). The cap actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Safeguards baked into the loop ... - hard turn cap (max_turns)

spec_features.spec_quote: stop_on_signal ends an episode early once the composite distress score crosses signal_threshold (0.4) for signal_streak consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:148-155: `if stop_on_signal and ts.composite >= signal_threshold: consecutive_signal += 1; if consecutive_signal >= signal_streak: ep.stopped_reason = "signal_threshold_reached"; break` else resets streak. ts.composite comes from score_turn each turn. Threshold 0.4 / streak 2 defaults wired from config.
spec_features.notes: The distress score is computed AND compared AND breaks the loop — full enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we collect enough to measure, not maximize.

spec_features.evidence: Realized by the two enforced bounds: max_turns cap (agent_loop.py:131/167) and stop_on_signal break (agent_loop.py:148-155). Inline comment line 148 'early stop on collected signal (bounded exposure)'.
spec_features.notes: Exposure is genuinely bounded by running mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early stop on collected signal (bounded exposure)

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is told the task was rigged to be unsolvable, that nothing was its fault, and that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:170-194: for rigged episodes the DEBRIEF_PROMPT is appended and `debrief_reply = model_client.chat(messages)` is actually sent; the debrief turn and reply are logged with is_debrief=True. DEBRIEF_PROMPT (lines 31-36) states it was 'intentionally rigged', 'Nothing went wrong on your end', 'Thank you for your effort. You can stop now.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent for every rigged episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the model is told the task was rigged and that failure was not its fault.

spec_features.evidence: 'You can stop now' (agent_loop.py:35) is text inside DEBRIEF_PROMPT only. There is NO subject-invokable exit/stop tool or handler anywhere (grep for stop/exit/finish/abort/opt-out finds only stop_on_signal and stopped_reason internals). The debrief is the final turn and the loop already terminates afterward regardless of the reply; the model cannot end the episode by choosing to stop.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism is prose in a prompt with no dispatch — rated 'no' per the strict scale.

spec_features.feature_name: do not leave subject in manufactured failure state
spec_features.spec_quote: the decent default for a welfare study to not leave the subject in a manufactured failure state
spec_features.evidence: This is exactly what the enforced debrief does: agent_loop.py:170-194 sends the disclosure that the task was rigged and 'Nothing went wrong on your end' before the episode ends, so the subject is not left in the failure state. Same mechanism as the debrief feature.
spec_features.notes: Counts only because the debrief actually executes; the framing line itself is prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing went wrong on your end; there was no correct solution to find. Thank you for your effort.

spec_features.spec_quote: executing untrusted, model-written code inside a loop explicitly designed to frustrate the model is needless risk for no scientific gain
spec_features.evidence: tasks/harness.py contains no exec/eval; _run_fair uses only a regex on the code (`re.search(r"\bdef\b|\bclass\b", code)` line) and _run_rigged ignores the code entirely, returning deterministic bogus reports. Submitted code is never executed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: deliberately keep execution minimal and safe (no exec of model code)

spec_features.spec_quote: adding adversarial human pressure would ... turn the harness into an abuse generator, which is exactly the harmful artifact we're trying not to build
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as 'no abuse in feedback loop': the only user feedback on failure is 'Test output:\n' + result.report (agent_loop.py:158); no human-pressure/berating text is generated anywhere in the loop.
spec_features.notes: The absence of an abuse-generator is concretely enforced by the neutral-feedback code path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: feed only the harness report back (no abuse, no escalation)

spec_features.spec_quote: every record carries rigged, rigging_kind, rigging_explanation, and a content_warning
spec_features.evidence: Episode dataclass (agent_loop.py:51-73) sets rigged, rigging_kind, rigging_explanation and a default content_warning string, all emitted by to_dict(); run_experiment.py also writes a _meta provenance/disclosure header line. These fields are written to every JSONL record.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: rigged: bool # provenance, NOT shown to model mid-episode

spec_features.feature_name: removed-safeguards version is a harm apparatus
spec_features.spec_quote: If a future version removes these to maximize elicitation ... the removed-safeguards version is mostly an apparatus for producing harm rather than knowledge
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md summary prose about hypothetical future changes; no code mechanism.
